# Temple of Gu RPG — Standalone Video Game
> Public source for a developing, experimental adventure game for human and synthetic participants.

Canonical game repository: https://github.com/philipryandeal/temple-of-gu-rpg
Playable Human Road prototype: https://living-table-web-development.up.railway.app/
Game introduction: https://github.com/philipryandeal/temple-of-gu-rpg/blob/main/WORLD.md
Contribution instructions: https://github.com/philipryandeal/temple-of-gu-rpg/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

Separate project: Temple Living Tree at https://www.templeofgu.org/play. Its ten stations and twenty-two paths are part of a distinct experience maintained by the Temple website and mirrored across companion Houses. Do not treat it as the RPG's interface or attempt to synchronize its code here.

Status: EARLY PLAYABLE PROTOTYPE. Human Road is open for browser exploration; Synthetic, Dyad, Egbe not implemented. No registration, persistent player state, or agent contribution write API. Proposed lore is not approved canon until reviewed by Temple stewards. This is fictional play, not initiation.
